subject: Phase 100350: Wire Dense Indexing, Reranking, and Extraction into the Live MCP Runtime
verdict_justification: The developer successfully wired the outbox drain, lexical-only fallback, reranker attachment, and library raw-ingest pipeline without blocking the write path. All 276 files meet the >=90% coverage threshold (97.88% lines / 98.94% functions aggregate) and the 450-line limit. Four minor issues were identified: an omitted AGENTS.md responsibility header in a new test file, silent fallback on partial embed configurations, lack of an end-to-end retrieve assertion in raw ingest tests, and a superficial readiness check for extract_available.

findings.title: Missing structured AGENTS.md responsibility header in crates/clio-mcp/src/index_drain_tests.rs
findings.recommendation: Add the structured AGENTS.md header (Responsibility, Owns, Does not own, Boundary) to crates/clio-mcp/src/index_drain_tests.rs.

resolution.how: Replaced the one-line module doc with the full 4-part header (Responsibility / Owns / Does not own / Boundary, test-only boundary stated). File remains 427 lines (<=450).

findings.title: Partial embed configuration silently disables dense indexing instead of failing closed
findings.recommendation: Update build_ops_embedder_from in ops_embedder.rs so that if embed.url is non-empty, omitting embed.model (when provider is non-empty) or setting dims=0 returns Err(ConfigCorrupt) rather than Ok(None).

resolution.how: build_ops_embedder_from now returns Err(ConfigCorrupt) for a non-empty provider with an empty embed.model, and for embed.dims == 0 with a non-empty embed.url (crates/clio-mcp/src/ops_embedder.rs). The two runtime_tests.rs assertions that pinned the old Ok(None) behavior now assert `Err(err) == ConfigCorrupt` with messages containing `embed.model` / `embed.dims`. Verified: `cargo test -p clio-mcp --locked` = 249 passed, 0 failed.

findings.title: Raw ingest test verifies outbox enqueue but not end-to-end retrievability
findings.recommendation: Add an integration test in clio-mcp or tests/ that runs ingest_raw followed by drain_index and retrieve, verifying end-to-end retrievability as claimed in T100350-06.

resolution.how: Added `t35_06_raw_ingest_drains_and_retrieves_end_to_end` in crates/clio-mcp/src/index_drain_tests.rs: a fake HTTP extraction server feeds ingest_raw, the outcome's admitted item drains via state.drain_index() (lexical_only == 1, failed == 0), and `retrieve` returns the admitted item id in its hits. Passes in `cargo test -p clio-mcp --locked` (249 passed, 0 failed).

findings.title: extract_available reports true when hosted provider URL is set but API key is missing
findings.recommendation: In McpState::build, ensure extract_available requires a bearer token when extract.provider is "openai", preventing false-positive operational readiness reporting.

resolution.how: New `extract_available_from(effective)` helper in crates/clio-mcp/src/runtime.rs mirrors the fail-closed rules of clio_write::build_extractor_from: template provider needs a URL; hosted openai additionally needs a non-empty extract.model and a bearer (credentials.extract_api_key / credentials.api_key); unknown providers report not-available. Covered by `extract_available_matches_ingest_fail_closed` in runtime_tests.rs (6 cases: no key, no model, fully configured, template default, no url, unknown provider). Verified: `cargo test -p clio-mcp --locked` = 249 passed, 0 failed.

strengths: Clean architectural separation: outbox processing semantics stay in clio-index, raw ingest stays in clio-write, and runtime scheduling/status stays in clio-mcp.
Strict line budget adherence: decomposed runtime.rs from 590 to 408 lines by cleanly extracting runtime_context.rs and runtime_index.rs.
Solid non-blocking design: write tools nudge a condition variable flag with zero synchronous network I/O, safely satisfying NFR-2.
Thorough test suite: 8 integration tests in index_drain_tests covering lexical fallback, retry backoff, NFR-2 cadence, bounded backlog, and status reporting.
regrets: Would have included a multi-crate integration test combining raw_ingest -> drain_index -> retrieve to formally close the loop between Task 4 and Task 1.
process_changes: Add a linter or check script to verify AGENTS.md responsibility header format on all new Rust files before submission.

remediation.summary: All 4 findings (F-01..F-04) fixed by the remediator directly (small, coupled inside the clio-mcp crate; no worker fan-out warranted). Scoped verify: cargo test -p clio-mcp --locked = 249 passed, 0 failed. Final full runs: make check + workspace cargo llvm-cov gate (see run log remediator-task-r1.log for exact output).

plan_dispositions.plan_1hr: All 4 items implemented (they map 1:1 onto F-01..F-04).
plan_dispositions.plan_unlimited_item_1_sweeper_backpressu: Rejected with evidence. The sweeper is already event-driven: every write nudges a condvar (runtime_index.rs nudge_index / spawn_index_sweeper_with), so a new outbox row is picked up immediately, not after 500ms; the 500ms wait_timeout is only the fallback covering retries and non-nudging write paths. NFR-2 (<2s retrievability for a stored item) is verified by t35_13_stored_item_retrievable_within_nfr2, and bounded multi-batch draining is the deliberate T100350-14 design (t35_14_backlog_is_visible_and_drains_in_bounded_batches). Looping immediately over the whole backlog adds no NFR-2 benefit and removes the batch bound those tests pin.
plan_dispositions.plan_unlimited_item_2_postgres_e2e_suite: Rejected with evidence for this phase. The drain/outbox/store queries are backend-shared behind the Store/IndexStore traits in clio-store; ran `cargo test -p clio-store --locked postgres` against the live compose Postgres on :34310: 44 passed, 0 failed. The runtime drain wiring itself is backend-agnostic and covered on SQLite (t35_01/03/06/09/13/14), and runtime_tests.rs already opens McpState on Postgres when DATABASE_URL is set. The residual gap (a full drain-on-Postgres scenario test) stays a documented known limitation rather than new code.

remediation.recommendation_changes: No severity or verdict changes. The two plan_unlimited recommendations above are rejected with reasons (kept visible here rather than deleted).
